title: Home Automation using Arduino IR Remote Control Sensor | Smart Home
subtitle: Control Home Appliances with an IR Remote and Arduino UNO
desc: Build a smart home automation system using an Arduino UNO, IR Remote, and Relay Module to control electrical appliances wirelessly.
fullDesc: This project demonstrates a simple and affordable home automation system using an Arduino UNO and an IR Remote Control. The Arduino receives commands from the IR receiver sensor and controls electrical appliances through a relay module. It introduces students to wireless communication, embedded systems, and smart home technology.
author: Dipavalee Sudrik
innovation: A low-cost smart home automation solution that enables wireless appliance control using an IR remote and Arduino, making home automation affordable for students and beginners.
problemStatement: Traditional electrical switches require manual operation and are not convenient for elderly people, people with disabilities, or users seeking smart home functionality.
solutionApproach: An Arduino UNO receives signals from an IR receiver sensor connected to an IR remote. Based on the received command, the Arduino switches the relay ON or OFF, allowing household electrical appliances such as lamps or bulbs to be controlled wirelessly.
guide: Connect the IR Receiver VCC to Arduino 5V.
Connect the IR Receiver GND to Arduino GND.
Connect the IR Receiver OUT pin to Arduino Digital Pin 2.
Connect the Relay Module IN pin to Arduino Digital Pin 13.
Connect Relay VCC to Arduino 5V and GND to Arduino GND.
Connect the Lamp Holder through the Relay Module following proper electrical safety guidelines.
Connect the Arduino UNO to the computer using a USB cable.
Open Arduino IDE and paste the provided Arduino code.
Upload the program to the Arduino UNO.
Point the IR Remote toward the IR Receiver and press Button 1 to turn the lamp ON or OFF.
